claims: Coachella 2026 tickets are for April 10-12 and April 17-19.
Original prices for GA tickets ranged from $549 to $649.
Original prices for VIP tickets ranged from $1,199 to $1,399.
Coachella 2026 tickets are now sold out.
Resale prices for weekend 1 tickets often exceed $2,500–$4,000+ on StubHub.
Resale prices for Weekend 2 tickets start around $800–$1,300+ as of April 2026.
General Admission (GA) 3-Day Pass originally cost $549–$649 for Weekend 2–Weekend 1.
Resale prices for GA Weekend 2 start over $950.
Resale prices for GA Weekend 1 go up to $4,000.
Coachella 2026 tickets sold out within a week of going on sale in September 2025.
